d: Short, golden-blonde hair with a side-swept fringe and a soft texture. Bright cornflower blue eyes with a cheerful, wide-eyed expression. A youthful appearance with a rounded, plump face. A stout, heavy-set build. A purple and cream mage's outfit consisting of a wide-brimmed purple pointed hat, a cream-colored cloak with gold trim, and voluminous purple trousers. Accessories include a large gold medallion with a blue star, gold star-shaped buttons, and a wooden staff topped with a large white flower and a golden star. BODY COLOR: Pale peach LEGS: Plantigrade with small, rounded feet.
